mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a decline in FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate capital expenditure and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 110.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in housing starts below 1800.0 thousand units indicates weak consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST below 1800.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production over the past month indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate investment and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with a decline in INDPRO, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
